modules.title: 改了资料，RAG 为什么还引用旧规则？

example.label: 退款政策更新与实际检索结果的教学案例

steps.label: 旧条款仍可检索
steps.demo:

steps.caption: 教学案例：当前资料库仍能检索到旧条款，客服答案也引用了它。

steps.label: 新文件仍在处理中
steps.demo:

客服答复不可以退。引用：政策第 3 条。
steps.caption: 文档虽已修改，但索引仍在处理；本次检索仍命中旧内容，不能据此说新规则已经可用。

action.label: 处理完成后用同一问题复查

steps.label: 检查完成后的命中内容
steps.demo:

steps.caption: 这次查询命中新条款且引用一致，才支持本次回答依据了新资料；其他问题仍要分别检查。

modules.title: 看状态，也看这次命中了什么

items.title: 处理完成是使用前提
items.text: 文件修改后，检索索引可能仍在处理。处理完成意味着资料可以被检索，不代表每个问题都会找到正确段落。

items.title: 答案要对照原文
items.text: 检查实际命中的段落是否支持回答。漏检、旧资料和模型误读都可能让答案不准确。

modules.title: 检索完成不等于答案正确
modules.text: RAG 把检索到的资料交给模型参考；它不保证找到正确段落、正确理解内容或按资料作答。

lessonPractice.title: 退款政策刚改过，资料列表仍显示“处理中”，AI 回答时也引用旧规则。下一步先检查什么？

options.label: 等资料处理完成后重问，并查看这次命中的段落
options.feedback: 对。资料还在处理中时，新内容可能还不在检索范围；完成后仍要确认是否命中新条款。

options.label: 把问题改写得更强调“按最新规则回答”
options.feedback: 更清楚的问题有帮助，但不能让尚未处理的新资料自动进入检索结果。

options.label: 用新政策重新训练模型，让它记住退款规则
options.feedback: 这会改变模型训练内容；更新这类外部政策应先确认检索资料已处理并被命中。

en.title: The refund policy was just edited, its file still says “processing,” and AI cites the old rule. What should you check first?

options.label: Wait for processing to finish, ask again, and inspect the passage retrieved
options.feedback: Correct. New content may not be in the searchable set while processing is underway; after it completes, confirm the new clause was actually retrieved.

options.label: Rewrite the question to emphasize “use the latest rule”
options.feedback: A clearer question can help, but it does not put an unprocessed file into retrieval results.

options.label: Retrain the model on the new policy so it remembers the refund rule
options.feedback: That changes model training; for an external policy update, first confirm the retrieval material finished processing and was found.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 我刚更新了退款政策。请先确认这份资料已经处理完成，再用同一个问题检查检索命中的段落和回答引用；如果仍命中旧规则或没有相关段落，请明确告诉我。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: I just updated the refund policy. First confirm that the file has finished processing, then ask the same question and inspect the retrieved passage and answer citation. Tell me if it still finds the old rule or no relevant passage.

learning.assumes: You know AI can answer questions and have seen it use company documents.
learning.outcome: You can check whether material is ready, what passage was actually retrieved, and whether the answer is supported.

action.label: Check the same query after processing

steps.label: Inspect the result when ready
steps.demo:
Support · refund question
Refund policy · teaching exampleFile status: complete
Policy text · Section 3All items may be returned within 7 days
Customer asksCan I return my custom mug?
Passage retrievedAll items may be returned within 7 days
Support replyYes. You may request a return within 7 days. Source: policy Section 3.
steps.caption: Only this matching passage and citation support that this answer used the new material. Other questions still need checking.

modules.title: Check both status and the retrieved passage

items.title: Completion is a prerequisite
items.text: After a file changes, its search index may still be processing. Completion makes the material available to search; it does not promise every query will find the right passage.

items.title: Compare the answer with its source
items.text: Check whether the retrieved passage supports the reply. Missed passages, outdated material, or a model misreading the source can still lead to an inaccurate answer.

modules.title: Retrieval does not guarantee a correct answer
modules.text: RAG gives retrieved material to a model as a reference. It does not guarantee the right passage is found, understood, or followed.

distinctions.label: Fine-tuning
distinctions.text: Fine-tuning continues training a model with examples; RAG retrieves external material when answering. A policy change usually requires updating and processing the retrieval material, not retraining the model.

distinctions.label: Pasting material into a question
distinctions.text: Pasting material supplies what the model should read for that request; RAG searches connected material for passages based on the question. Neither guarantees the model will understand correctly.
